subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are given below. Which is the number on the face opposite the face containing 5?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/403a8e3f5768b2d090b6f1b7292ca1b1544c89ab0a1c35fc7c4dbc8e9624f31c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b43fef2b3672e4630d4b42c33354ed831abb8034b548d2455ba0fc6d9b0e39b.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of '5', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7d1615b36a96d95612ca66b82eb80357665335de925b060bf8000d2f2155625.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92584d043aeeea3a5cb69e920d50f02f41a974279d5a3d4a7d98f276a2f07df3.png] 

From both dices, 2 is common and on the same surface. So, all remaining surface will be opposite to each other.

3 is opposite to 4.

So, 1 will be opposite to 5.

Hence, the correct answer is "1".
